definitions.explanation: Body tissue that contracts to produce movement.

examples.japanese: {筋肉|きんにく}を{鍛|きた}える。
{彼|かれ}は{筋肉|きんにく}がすごい。
{運動|うんどう}をしないと{筋肉|きんにく}が{落|お}ちる。
examples.english: If you don't exercise, you'll lose muscle.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}たくさん{歩|ある}いたので、{今日|きょう}は{足|あし}の{筋肉|きんにく}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: I walked a lot yesterday, so my leg muscles hurt today.

notes:
{筋肉|きんにく} refers to muscle tissue in the body.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {筋肉|きんにく}を{鍛|きた}える (to train/build muscles)
- {筋肉|きんにく}がつく (to gain muscle)
- {筋肉|きんにく}が{落|お}ちる (to lose muscle)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {筋肉|きんにく}{痛|つう} (muscle pain, DOMS)
- {筋肉|きんにく}{質|しつ} (muscular build)
- {筋肉|きんにく}トレーニング (muscle training, weightlifting)

CASUAL TERM:
- {筋トレ|きんとれ} (muscle training - abbreviation)
